$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: Switch
whenToUse: A setting that takes effect the moment it’s flipped — no Save button.
Turning a feature, service or notification on and off.

whenNotToUse.text: A choice that applies when a form is submitted
Two named options that aren’t on/off (Monthly / Yearly)
A button that starts an action

anatomy.description: on/off; `tone` warning or danger for risky settings.
names the setting, not the action (“Auto-renew”, not “Turn on auto-renew”).
`checkIcon` marks “on” with a shape, not only color.

do.caption: Applies at once and says what “on” does.
do.example: <Switch defaultChecked label="Auto-renew" description="Renews 14 days before expiry." />

dont.caption: A switch inside a form that still needs Save — use a checkbox for both.

a11y: It’s a `role="switch"`: announced as “on/off”, toggled with Space.
Without a visible label pass `aria-label` — in a table row, name the row (“Auto-renew for seashell.shop”).
If flipping it fails, set it back and say why next to it — don’t leave a switch showing a state the server didn’t accept.

props.name: checkIcon
props.description: Shows a checkmark inside the thumb when on. Default true — set false to hide it.
